title: Gating agent tool calls with PreToolUse hooks
summary: Fail-closed decision hooks for Claude Code and Codex: safe-command fast paths, chained-command bypass protection, and observe/prompt/enforce modes. Implemented and tested in the repo.

title: Directory guarding & secret scrubbing for stdio MCP servers
summary: Allowed-roots path validation, destructive-command deny patterns, and regex credential redaction of subprocess output — the policy and redaction modules carry the unit tests.

title: Deterministic risk analysis for MCP tool manifests
summary: Accepts a raw MCP tools/list response and returns capability risks, severity, and missing security controls using transparent, explainable rules — it never executes or probes the listed tools.

title: Explainable risk scoring for AI-agent inventories
summary: Stores declared agent metadata and computes a 0-100 risk score from permissions, data access, and tool descriptions — readiness labels and human-readable factors, not runtime enforcement.

title: Human approval queues for agent actions
summary: Classifies an action's risk deterministically, queues it for a human decision, and records approve/reject with reasons — the calling system waits for and enforces the recorded decision.

title: Deterministic prompt-risk scanning
summary: A small rule set flags instruction overrides, jailbreak markers, and exfiltration intent with evidence excerpts and remediation guidance — an auditable first-pass filter, honestly labelled heuristic.
